saw_lines: People buying a TV stand picture the cables and game consoles first, then pick the one that hides them.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, when a shopper sees whether the stand fits their setup.
Your site shows 152 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Buyers check reviews before paying, so put 152 reviews on every creative and open two ads with a review quote about setup.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 152 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Buyers check reviews before paying. Put 152 reviews on every creative, in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote about setup.

Your site offers free shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A new buyer wondering about delivery has no reason to click. Answer the shipping question in the first line of ads for new buyers, naming free shipping.
Creator posts run as brand ads

All 10 of your ads are creator posts with a code or @mention, run from your brand page. That makes the brand look like a reseller, not the maker. Whitelist the best posts from the creator account and cut three variations.

20 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so buyers scroll past without a reason to stop. Add three story ads, each showing one stand in a real room with one line about the problem it solves.

ads_1: Real room story ads opening on reviews and free shipping, not creator posts
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Youtube
